citation.authors: Eshghi SR, Fletcher K, Myette-Côté É, et al.
citation.title: Glycemic and Metabolic Effects of Two Long Bouts of Moderate-Intensity Exercise in Men with Normal Glucose Tolerance or Type 2 Diabetes

population.description: Six healthy men without diabetes (Table 1, mean ± SD). Only the healthy group is entered; the six men with T2D are left out. The day-1 rest condition and the day-1 first exercise bout are entered; the day-2 exercise condition is not.

protocols.name: day1_rest_fasted_90min
protocols.description: Day 1 rest condition: sedentary 09:00-10:30 in the fasted state, blood at 09:00 and 10:30

protocols.name: day1_exercise_fasted_90min
protocols.description: Day 1 exercise condition, first bout: treadmill walking 09:00-10:30 fasted, blood at 09:00 and 10:30. Activity from the printed METs of healthy men in this bout, Table 2: 7.25 (9h00-9h10) and 7.59 (10h20-10h30) METs, mean 7.42 METs; 7.42 x 3.5 = 25.97 mL/kg/min; level = (25.97 - 3.7) / 31.7 = 0.7025

protocols.name: day2_ogtt_rest
protocols.description: Day 2 after the day-1 rest condition: fasting blood samples 15 min and 0 min before the 75 g OGTT (here t=15 and t=30), calorimetry in the 10 min before the OGTT; arm ends after the last fasting sample
